decision: PASS reporting implementation and saved-observation recomputation
scope: Reporting-only evaluator change; original live implementation/source freeze unchanged, no new provider run

rates.unit: One expected proposition matched to exactly one valid factual result; completed checks include abstentions, definitive-only checks exclude them.

falseAlarm.definition: Expected supported (true), predicted contradicted or misleading.

limitations: Gold misleading is not interpreted as a binary truth label; unlabeled cases are excluded.
No-result, duplicate-result, malformed-verdict and not-observed outcomes are excluded from both observed denominators, never counted as true negatives.
Abstentions remain visible and in completed-check denominators; lower error rates with more abstention do not establish useful coverage.
These empirical finite-cohort rates do not estimate population accuracy or certify source verification.

reviewFindings: False alarm explicitly means true-gold predicted contradicted/misleading; false support means false-gold predicted supported.
Both completed-check denominators including visible abstentions and definitive-only denominators are reported.
Missing/invalid/duplicate/not-observed outcomes never count as definitive true negatives; binary misleading gold and unlabeled examples excluded and surfaced separately.
Original first-run report unchanged; post-run metrics wrapper includes hash/source provenance.
